stops.name: Gornergrat Railway
stops.quote: The adventure begins with the ride on the Gornergrat Railway which offers magnificent views of the Matterhorn.
stops.english: The adventure begins with the ride on the Gornergrat Railway which offers magnificent views of the Matterhorn.

stops.name: Matterhorn
stops.quote: In summer, marvel at the reflection of the Matterhorn in the surface of the Riffelsee and enjoy scenic hiking trails to the Alpine Garden or the famous Valais Blacknose Sheep.
stops.english: In summer, marvel at the reflection of the Matterhorn in the surface of the Riffelsee and enjoy scenic hiking trails to the Alpine Garden or the famous Valais Blacknose Sheep.

stops.name: ZOOOM the Matterhorn
stops.quote: The Gornergrat is also home to the multimedia experience “ZOOOM the Matterhorn”, the “Golden Spot” photo point, and a viewing platform, which can be visited all year round.

stops.name: Dufourspitze
stops.quote: Surrounded by more than two dozen four-thousand-metre peaks – including the Matterhorn, the imposing Dufourspitze and the Dom – and several glaciers, Gornergrat rewards with an unforgettable panorama.
